tips_en: Start with the GameHorizon Suite paper, as it provides the broadest contribution—a unified benchmark that reveals how current AI models perform across temporal horizons in complex interactive environments, making it valuable regardless of your focus. RRSI is a natural second read if you're interested in agent self-improvement, since its regularization insights could apply to the game agents evaluated by GameHorizon. All three papers share a thread around long-horizon reasoning: WorldCrafter tackles temporal consistency in generated video worlds, GameHorizon measures multi-horizon gameplay planning, and RRSI addresses how agents can iteratively improve without overfitting—making them complementary reading for anyone studying temporal AI capabilities.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读GameHorizon Suite这篇论文，因为它贡献最为广泛——提供了一个统一的基准测试，揭示了当前AI模型在复杂交互环境中跨时间维度的表现，无论你关注哪个方向都很有价值。如果你对智能体自我改进感兴趣，RRSI是顺理成章的第二选择，其正则化洞见可应用于GameHorizon所评估的游戏智能体。三篇论文都围绕长时程推理展开：WorldCrafter解决生成视频世界中的时序一致性，GameHorizon衡量多时程游戏规划能力，RRSI则关注智能体如何在不发生过拟合的情况下迭代改进——它们对研究时序AI能力具有互补价值。
